title: Heatmap Pass 2 — The Ruled-Out Register

grading_scale.CLOSED-STRONG: Falsified by a well-powered, pre-registered test whose own stop conditions fired correctly. Revisiting needs new data or a materially different question, not a better method.
grading_scale.CLOSED-INSTRUMENT: The instrument was found defective - the finding is about the instrument, not the world. Underlying question may be entirely open.
grading_scale.NULL-UNDERPOWERED: Could not distinguish the effect from zero at the available n. Not a falsification.
grading_scale.CONFOUNDED: Blocked before it could answer, by a population or design problem.
grading_scale.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later, better-specified version of the same question.
grading_scale.ABANDONED-UNTESTED: Dropped for cost/scope/judgment without ever being measured.

rulings.question: Can an in-house zero-skill persistence null be established via split-half classification on the actual twice-classifiable population?
rulings.measured: synthetic-cohort split-half denominator=6, below adequacy floor of 10 (comparison=16, pooled=15 both cleared). Population 753 traders, 28563 synthetic positions, REPS=10000, SYNTH_SEED=20260906.
rulings.what_would_reopen_it: A persistence-cohort-specific population >~250-300 traders with >=20 positions each (vs 146-trader cohort's actual size) - current post-split activity cannot supply this without new history.
rulings.dead_as_result: none - halted correctly per its own pre-registration, immediately superseded by A3/A4 within same arc.

rulings.question: Does the presence of a directionally-skilled trader in a market mark that market for later mispricing, beyond what any active well-matched trader cohort would predict?
rulings.measured: Part1 base-rate gap +3.97pp [+2.16,+5.78] (no trip). Part2 matched comparison (2743 pairs, 66.4% match rate): direction preserved 6/6 horizons (no trip). Part3 placebo (1494 activity-matched non-skill-selected, match_control seed=42): replicated elevation at 4/6 horizons at near-identical magnitude (e.g. ~0.5h: matched-present-skilled 1.369 vs placebo-present 1.352) - stop tripped, halted before Part4.
rulings.what_would_reopen_it: Source doc: 'can rule out skill explains most/all of the gap; cannot rule out a small residual skill-specific contribution beneath the placebo's own noise floor' - needs much larger n or within-category (not pooled) placebo replication.
rulings.dead_as_result: No code killed - Part4 never built (gated closed by design).

rulings.question: Does LEGENDARY-tier trader presence in a market mark it for later mispricing?
rulings.measured: n=9 traders, 697 markets present. Part1 base rate +4.15pp [+0.54,+7.77] (no trip). Part2 matched comparison (650 pairs): direction REVERSES at 5/6 horizons (e.g. ~3h: matched-present 1.147 vs matched-absent 1.398; only ~3d preserves direction) - stop tripped, halted before Part3 (placebo never run).
rulings.what_would_reopen_it: n=9 intrinsically small - design feature of condemned LEGENDARY definition (condemned_c2), not a power problem. Needs a differently-defined elite tier on a sound instrument.
rulings.dead_as_result: Confirms condemned_c2's earlier overlap-based finding with a stronger causal method - reinforces, doesn't newly kill.

rulings.question: Does NEAR_LEGENDARY-tier trader presence in a market mark it for later mispricing?

rulings.what_would_reopen_it: Same structural issue as A9 - sound replacement tier needed first.
rulings.dead_as_result: none additional

rulings.question: Does Pool C (broad clean-pool) trader presence mark a market for later mispricing?
rulings.measured: n=4483 traders, 8777 markets present, 986 absent. Base rate present 30.8%, absent 14.2%, gap +16.62pp [+14.24,+19.00] - clears 10pp stop by a wide margin. rulings.what_would_reopen_it: Redefine 'absent' comparison population to require a minimum trading-activity floor, so comparison is present-vs-absent-but-actively-traded, not traded-vs-never-traded. A population-construction fix, not more data.

rulings.question: Can the cascade relevance classifier reach >=95% relevance recall, >=90% directional agreement, and pass precision/adjudication thresholds, to become the canonical markets.category decision authority?
rulings.grade: CLOSED-STRONG on the measured recall question; institutional disposition unresolved (human adjudication pending)
rulings.measured: Full run, 12052-row corpus, zero classify errors. Overall relevance recall 90.35% (10889/12052) vs >=95% - FAIL, 561 rows short (4.6pp under). All 6 per-stratum cells FAIL (87.62%-92.49%). Directional agreement 90.12% - PASS narrowly. Precision PASSED all 3 measures. Follow-up 100-row diagnostic: 79% of disagreements are genuine classifier misses (8% stale labels, 13% ambiguous) - diffuse across 18 subtypes, plus real but insufficient batch-position degradation (5.6%->12.2%, position 1->20). Matches design's SS3.11(a) abandon criterion, not SS3.11(b) retry.
rulings.explicitly_pending: Design names Oscar as SS3.10 adjudicator, reserves SS3.11 abandon-vs-retry call for him. Gate-result doc declines to declare overall verdict. Nothing after 2026-09-04 records adjudication happening.
rulings.what_would_reopen_it: Formally nothing reopens the measurement (corpus spent per SS3.11.2). Closing needs Oscar's SS3.10 adjudication over the characterized disagreement pools (1163 NotRelevant + 1076 directional mismatches, 10 precision disagreements) and his SS3.11(a)/(b) call.
